S.FORM: Odis Alliso mhtuw ryax tya 2 na byacing 10 nquw kawas ta 1949 squw Amerika. nalan unroing NBA pzyuwi mari na yawa,198cm kinwagiq nya ruw 88kg kinusuw nya, kki'an nya squw pzyuwi mari ga te gleng, mqwasbiru riygak na UNVL, KAWAS te 1971 ga maki squw sinsyuw te zmagal wal nya galunu , qyax niya mtama thekan squw NBA ga min 36 pispngan nya.
